about_the_game:
NOMIA is a story-focused isometric tactics roguelike. It's like Final Fantasy Tactics meets Slay the Spire.

Two heroes, two hands; no one should die the same way twice.

This is a work in progress; the demo represents a fully-featured beta of the game.

Your hand has two halves.

Your Actions persist between turns, but have charges and cooldowns.
Your Gambits are drawn from your deck each turn, and are discarded when played.

Set up combos with your ever-reliable Actions, or execute masterstrokes by drafting and drawing just the right Gambits.

Your party has two heroes.

The Mighty has more Actions.
The Magical has more Gambits.

Each has a deck of 50 cards, and they can access a pool of 100+ Memories both unique and shared which create powerful synergies.

Chain together martial and mystical abilities to overcome the many challenges in your path.

Your foes have tells.

Enemy intents and incoming damage are shown before you commit any movement. Comprehensive preview information drives clever defense and brilliant counterplays.

Outsmart your foes with precise movement, solid defense, or by drawing their attention with an attack to protect your ally. Or, simply kick them off a cliff with the right positioning and the right knockback card.

Your path is winding.

Each of the five realms features its own enemies, items, and terrain. Battle mechanically unique foes and powerful bosses as you grow in strength and complexity.

Discover the truth behind a mysterious disappearance as a stone-eating scourge devours your home.

Dive deep into the Dream, and play your cards well.

content_descriptors.notes:
The core gameplay features stylized, non-bloody combat against non-human foes. Characters are represented by illustrations on a board, like chess pieces. There is a status effect that represents bleeding, but blood is not shown except as a small droplet icon.

The story involves themes such as grief and generational trauma.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

name: NOMIA

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
